info.description: Rental management for houses, apartments and parking boxes under French law. Every amount is in cents; every error is an RFC 9457 problem with a stable type.
info.title: Tenure API

post.summary: Add an asset

post.description: One record per kind; a kind the asset does not need is declared with not_required_reason (Q-23).
post.summary: Record an asset's diagnostic

get.description: Version 0 until the layout is seeded or saved. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: An asset's layout: its rooms and their elements

put.description: The whole layout in order, with If-Match on its version (W/"0" before the first save). A room or element left out is removed; ids keep past inventories linked.

post.description: From the latest template of the asset's kind (RENT-INV-001 §4): bedrooms numbered, rooms needing an absent feature left out, the furniture of a furnished dwelling added. Refused when the asset has rooms.
post.summary: Seed an asset's first layout from a template

get.description: The periods the asset had no lease, from its acquisition (or else its first lease) to today, the last open while it lasts, and the vacant days of each calendar year (RENT-SPEC-010, Q-119). A draft lease occupies nothing.

get.summary: List the scope's audit events, with their chain hashes

get.description: Step-up required; the export is itself recorded as an audit event.
get.summary: Export the scope's audit events as CSV
List the scope's daily audit chain heads

get.description: Each with its label and the last four IBAN characters; the full IBAN is never stored (RENT-SPEC-013, Q-123).

post.description: A label, and the last four IBAN characters to tell accounts apart.
post.summary: Record a bank account

get.description: The imported bank lines, the latest booked first, by account and status; an unmatched line past the alert delay is flagged stale.

post.description: Matches, without asking, every unmatched credit with one sure suggestion (the rent call's number, the tenant's name and amount, or an allowance naming the tenant); the amount-and-period rule alone and any ambiguity stay for the owner. dry_run only lists them.
post.summary: Match the sure bank credits

get.description: A whole statement (every unpaid charge of one asset and day adding up to the debit, as a syndic call), then each unpaid charge of the debit's amount, charged near its day (Q-125). A credit, or a line already matched or ignored, has none.
get.summary: The charges a bank debit may pay

post.description: The confirmed charges the debit paid, adding up to exactly its amount and paid by no other line: each is paid on the line's day and names it, so the charges ledger is bank-backed; the line becomes matched.
post.summary: Match a bank debit to charges

post.description: Records the credit as payments of the leases it is split across (a third party may pay; one line may pay several leases), adding up to its amount; each is paid on the line's day and applied to the lease's oldest unpaid rent calls. The line becomes matched.
post.summary: Match a bank credit to rent

post.description: Ignore an unmatched line (a transfer between one's own accounts, a bank fee), with a note, or reopen an ignored one. A matched line is refused.
post.summary: Ignore or reopen a bank line

get.description: Strongest rule first (Q-124): the rent call's number and the amount owed; a tenant's name and the amount owed; a housing allowance (CAF, MSA) naming a tenant, for at most the amount owed; the amount owed, booked near the call's due day. A debit, or a line already matched or ignored, has none.
get.summary: The rent calls a bank credit may pay

post.description: Issues a cancelling document and, when the lease is still billed for the period, a new rent call; both are archived and e-mailed.
post.summary: Cancel a rent call and reissue it

post.description: dry_run returns the computed fees without issuing; otherwise rent calls are issued, archived and e-mailed. A second run of the same period issues nothing new.
post.summary: Run the monthly billing of the scope for a period

get.description: Every dated obligation Tenure derives from what it holds (RENT-SPEC-012, computed base): diagnostics' end of validity, IRL revisions, ends of notice and of term, the yearly home insurance certificate, the entry inventory's completion windows, the deposit restitution deadline. From from to to (today and the next 90 days by default, three years at most), always with the overdue ones; for one asset with asset_id. Not for an accountant.

post.summary: Record a charge

post.description: The statement exported as CSV is uploaded first (POST /documents, scanned); one draft charge per line keeps the syndic's recoverable split. A statement the mapping cannot read whole imports nothing.
post.summary: Import a syndic statement into draft charges

put.description: Confirms an imported line or overrides its recoverable part; a charge of an issued reconciliation never changes.

Every line accepted or refused, with If-Match on the request's version; issues the EC document. The issued entry is not edited: the accepted lines complete it in the exit pre-fill and the comparison. A decided request no longer changes.

get.description: Per asset: rent, other income, expenses, net, gross and net yield on the acquisition price (a year's worth), vacant and occupied days, provisions received against recoverable charges paid, arrears aged by dashboard.aging. For the portfolio: the same summed, the bank's movements and the income and expenses by month, the year to date against the same days of the previous year, and the tax estimate under both regimes when the year has its 2044 map. Every figure comes from the owner's journal, the tax summary's split (RENT-SPEC-016, Q-129).
One row per asset, then the portfolio; amounts in cents, yields in basis points (Q-129). Requires a recent multi-factor login; the export is audited.
An accountant sees financial classes only.

post.description: multipart/form-data, the form fields first and the file last. The file streams to quarantine, its type is sniffed (PDF, JPEG, PNG; CSV or OFX by extension), the antivirus scans it, and only a clean file is archived under compliance lock. 25 MB at most. A signed copy names the generated document it signs.

get.summary: Get an export and, once ready, its 10-minute link

get.description: The content is never streamed through the API; every link issued is recorded as an audit event.
get.summary: Get a 10-minute download link to a document

get.description: Revoked grants included: a grant is revoked, never deleted. A grantee sees only their own.

post.description: As co-owner (reads everything) or accountant (financial data, no tenant contact data). A step-up route.
post.summary: Give a Socrate subject read access to the portfolio

delete.description: Sets revoked_at; the grantee's next request no longer reaches the scope. A step-up route.

post.description: The deposit receipt (DG) of a deposit held, or the acte de cautionnement (CA) of a surety, one per guarantor (RENT-SPEC-008).
post.summary: Generate a guarantee's document

get.description: Header, rooms and items, meters, keys, the parties who sign and the open checks. The ETag is the inventory's version. Not for an accountant.

put.description: The date it is done (never in the future), the appointment, the place and the general observations, with If-Match on the inventory's version. Until the inventory is completed.

get.description: Each exit item against its entry item (same, better, worse, missing, new), the keys, and the number of worse or missing results to qualify before the deposit settlement. The entry is corrected by its accepted completion lines. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: An exit compared with its entry

get.description: The windows (loi 89-462 art. 3-2): ten days after the entry, and the first month of the heating season when the entry was done outside it; which are open today; every request with its lines and, once decided, its EC document. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: An entry's completion windows and requests

post.description: The reason (ten_day or heating), the day the request was made, within its window, the tenant's letter when uploaded (POST /documents, class inventory, this lease), and one line per entry item with the state asked for. A heating request covers heating items only. It waits for the owner's decision.
post.summary: Record a tenant's request to complete an issued entry

post.description: In a room of the inventory (room_id or its label) or a new room. In a draft or on site.

put.description: Condition on the scale, works, quantity and comment, with If-Match on the item's version; clears « to check ». In a draft or on site.
The whole list, with If-Match on the inventory's version. Until completed.
put.summary: Replace an inventory's keys and access devices

put.description: The whole list, with If-Match on the inventory's version; an id keeps a meter and its photos, and a meter with photos cannot be removed. Until completed.

post.description: multipart/form-data: item_id or meter_id first, the file last. The upload waits in quarantine while the antivirus scans it; a JPEG or PNG is then turned upright, stripped of every metadata (EXIF, location) and re-encoded to JPEG, and the cleaned file is archived under compliance lock. 25 MB at most. Not on an issued inventory; owner only.
post.summary: Add a photo to an inventory item or meter

get.description: The photo is never streamed through the API; the link is shown inline and every link issued is recorded as an audit event. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: Get a 10-minute link to an inventory photo

get.description: Unnumbered and not archived, marked as a draft: printed to be signed by hand, then uploaded as the signed copy. Only once the capture is completed.
get.summary: The completed inventory as a PDF to sign

get.description: The signing links of a pending request are shown to the owner only. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: An inventory's parties, signatures and electronic request

post.description: wet_scan: the signed copy (uploaded through POST /documents, class inventory, this lease) and the parties who signed it, with their reservations. esign: a request to the signature provider for every party still to sign, each with an e-mail; the answer carries one link per party, opened on the tablet in turn. When the last party has signed, the inventory is issued into its EE document.
post.summary: Sign a completed inventory

post.description: At the provider and in Tenure, so the parties may sign by hand instead.
post.summary: Cancel the pending electronic request

post.description: Records each party who has signed; once all have, archives the signed file as evidence and issues the EE document. Called after each party signs on the tablet; no webhook.
post.summary: Read the pending electronic request at the provider

post.description: schedule (with scheduled_at and place), start (the date becomes today unless set), complete (the mandatory mentions checked), reopen, issue (a signed inventory into its EE document). With dry_run the answer is a TransitionResult (allowed, checks) and nothing changes.
post.summary: Move an inventory along its lifecycle

get.description: The system templates and the owner's own, newest version first within each asset kind. Not for an accountant.
get.summary: The inventory templates the scope can read

post.description: An admin runs it for every owner; an owner for their own scope only. A dry run computes and records nothing.
post.summary: Run a job now

parameters.name: state

post.description: Checks every lease rule at save: one ownership across the assets, zone ceiling, relocation rule.
post.summary: Draft a lease

post.description: A rent change outside IRL (the deposit held never changes), a new tenant or an added box; issues the numbered amendment AV-… (RENT-SPEC-008).
post.summary: Amend a current lease

get.description: Every live rent call with something left to pay, overdue after its due day; no penalty is computed.
Generation and activation blockers of a draft lease, and the warnings of any lease (RENT-SPEC-008 owner view).
get.summary: List what blocks a lease's contract and activation

post.description: CT-<asset>-<YYYY>-<seq>, from the lease, its assets, owner, tenants, guarantees and diagnostics (RENT-SPEC-008). Refused with the type of the first blocker; GET /leases/{id}/blockers lists them all.
post.summary: Generate the contract of a draft lease

get.description: The grid, the exit items worse or missing and the missing keys, the deductions, the next statement (wait_exit, initial, release, done) previewed as of today, and the statements issued. Not for an accountant, who reads the RD documents.

post.description: On an exit item worse or missing at exit (exit_item_id), or a missing key line (key), qualified by the owner as the tenant's; the cost from a quote or invoice uploaded through POST /documents (class supporting, this lease). The tenant's share comes from the lease's wear grid for the item's category and age; without a grid, the whole cost.
post.summary: Retain a deduction from the deposit

post.description: The first statement (RD) deducts the deductions and the unpaid rent calls, holds back a share in a collective building whose accounts are not approved (accounts_approved_on absent), adds the late penalty owed, and is due from the return of the keys; release: true issues the second, releasing the holdback net of the regularisation backed by its document, due from the approval. dry_run computes it only. The deductions no longer change once the first is issued.
post.summary: Issue the deposit restitution statement

get.summary: List the documents generated from a lease

get.description: An accountant does not see the guarantor.

post.summary: Add a guarantee to a lease

post.description: From its uploaded document (class inventory, this lease); recorded once.
post.summary: Record a lease's entry or exit inventory

get.description: The notice that ends the lease (RENT-SPEC-010): who gave it, its ground, when it was received and how, and the end it set. Not for an accountant.

post.description: The tenant's notice, with its reduced-notice ground if any, or the owner's on the letter generated for the lease, received on a date: tenure computes the end (Q-118) and the lease moves to notice. One notice per lease; dry_run only computes.
post.summary: Record a notice and put the lease under notice

post.description: For an active unfurnished or furnished lease, on a legal ground (sale with its price, repossession with its beneficiary, legitimate ground), never to a protected tenant without a rehousing offer: the letter for the end of the next term it can still reach, with the last day the tenant must receive it. dry_run only computes the term.
post.summary: Prepare the owner's notice letter (CG)

get.description: Where the recovery stands (RENT-SPEC-011, Q-121): the arrears, the episode's first overdue due day, the steps done, the next steps with the day each falls due, the clause résolutoire's day after a commandement de payer, and the lease's natural-person sureties.
get.summary: The recovery of a lease's unpaid rent

post.description: The formal notice (mise en demeure, MD) or the information of a natural-person surety (IC) of the overdue rent calls and their total. Nothing overdue is refused. dry_run only lists the debt.
post.summary: Prepare a recovery letter (MD or IC)

post.description: The plan agreed on a day covers every rent call overdue on it and their whole debt, in instalments adding up to it on increasing days; while respected (instalments paid within their grace, the current rent paid) it suspends the recovery. One plan in force per lease. dry_run only checks it.
post.summary: Record a payment plan of overdue rent

post.description: Cancels the lease's latest payment plan on a day, which ends its suspension of the recovery. A completed or cancelled plan is refused.
post.summary: Cancel a payment plan

post.description: A step done on a day, immutable: the formal notice or the surety's information on its letter, the insurer's claim with its deadline, the commandement de payer and its notice to the surety, the court referral, each with its delivery, reference and deed if uploaded. Needs something overdue on its day.
post.summary: Record a recovery step

post.description: For an active unfurnished lease outside rent control: the proposed rent and its references (three, six in an agglomeration of more than a million inhabitants), at most the cap of a zone tendue, for the next renewal the proposal can still reach; the increase in yearly steps, thirds or sixths. A proposal not yet received is replaced. dry_run only computes.
post.summary: Prepare the proposal of a new rent at renewal (PR)

get.description: The owner's proposals of a new rent at the renewal of an unfurnished lease (RENT-SPEC-010, loi 89-462 art. 17-2, Q-120), the latest renewal first: the references, the schedule of steps, the reception, the tenant's answer and the steps applied and due.

post.description: The tenant's agreement or refusal of a received proposal, on a day. A refusal leaves the rent as it is (conciliation, then the judge, Q-120).
post.summary: Record the tenant's answer to a rent re-evaluation proposal

post.description: The day the tenant received the proposal, at the latest its lead time before the term, and how it was delivered.
post.summary: Record the reception of a rent re-evaluation proposal

post.description: Adds to the lease's rent the share of the increase of each step whose day has come, on top of any IRL revision since the letter. dry_run only computes.
post.summary: Apply the due steps of an accepted rent re-evaluation

post.description: Applies the revision from its first billing period (never retroactively) and issues the revision notice; dry_run only computes it.
post.summary: Apply the IRL revision due today on a lease

get.description: The first term, then each renewed tacitly for the same duration (loi 89-462 art. 10, 25-7), each past, current or upcoming; the term the lease's end cuts short; the next renewal; beyond_term when a lease that does not renew runs past its term (RENT-SPEC-010, Q-119).

post.summary: Move a lease along its lifecycle (activate, notice, end, close)

put.description: Or remove it (null), until the deposit is settled.
put.summary: Annex a wear grid to a lease

get.description: Every movement of the year posted on a cash basis, in double entry, to the accounts of the chart in legal_params: rent received (rent, provisions, unapplied), charges paid (their recoverable part to the provisions account), loan instalments, deposits received (a liability) and deposit statements; and the balance of each account. closed says the year's tax summary is issued: what it was computed from no longer changes (Q-127).
get.summary: The owner's journal of a year

get.description: The eighteen fields of LPF art. A47 A-1, tab-separated, ISO 8859-15, dates AAAAMMJJ, amounts with a decimal comma; only for a closed year, validated the day its tax summary was issued (Q-128). Requires a recent multi-factor login; the export is audited.
get.summary: The year's fichier des écritures comptables

get.description: One row per line of each entry, numbered, amounts in cents (Q-128). Requires a recent multi-factor login; the export is audited.

A ZIP of the journal, the balances, the index of the supporting documents and a note; for a closed year, the FEC and the issued 2044 lines too (Q-128). Requires a recent multi-factor login; the export is audited.
The loans financing the scope's assets, of one asset with asset_id, each with its totals by year and without its instalments (RENT-SPEC-014, Q-126).

post.description: Without instalments, the table is computed: a fixed rate, constant monthly instalments, the interest of each month the balance times the annual rate divided by twelve, to the cent half-up, the last instalment closing the balance. With instalments, it is the bank's table as typed in, checked to repay the principal (Q-126). Each instalment due in an income year puts its interest and insurance on line 250 of the tax summary.

Grids entered by the owner from a collective agreement or agreed by the parties (INV-OD-08: none is shipped). Not for an accountant.

reminder_on.description:
ReminderOn is the day the reminder is due (due day + the
receipt_due_days_before_reminder parameter).

carry_over_cents.description:
CarryOverCents is the part of a credit that did not fit on this fee and
moves to the next one (always <= 0, OPEN-QUESTIONS Q-17).

base_cents.description: BaseCents is the monthly amount before proration (rent and provision).

reference.description:
Reference names the regularisation statement; Instalment/Of say which
monthly instalment this is when the balance is spread.

due_cents.description: DueCents is the instalments past their day and grace.

next_instalment.description:
NextInstalment is the first instalment not yet covered by the
payments.

paid_cents.description:
PaidCents is what the covered calls received since: the debt less
what they still owe.

reason.description: Reason says why a plan is broken.

plan.description: Plan is the lease's latest payment plan and where it stands.

resolution_on.description:
ResolutionOn is the day the clause résolutoire may take effect, the
delay after the commandement de payer having run.

since.description:
Since is the due day of the oldest overdue call: the episode starts
there, and the steps done since belong to it.

suspended.description:
Suspended says a respected payment plan suspends the escalation: no
step is called for while it holds.

deadline_on.description:
DeadlineOn is a date the step sets: the insurer's deadline, as the
owner records it.

capped_by.description:
CappedBy names the rule that limited the rent: "irl_cap" or
"rent_control.zone_ceiling"; empty when uncapped.

ceiling_cents.description:
CeilingCents is the zone ceiling of a controlled-zone lease (0 when none
applies). AboveCeiling is set when the current rent already exceeds it:
the revision then leaves the rent unchanged and the owner is told (Q-34).

effective_from.description:
EffectiveFrom is the first period billed at the new rent; there is no
retroactive billing of earlier periods (OPEN-QUESTIONS Q-13).

forfeited.description:
Forfeited is true when the anniversary is more than 12 months before
EffectiveFrom: the revision is lost and the rent is unchanged.

indexed_rent_cents.description: IndexedRentCents is old × current ÷ reference, before any cap.

ref.description:
Ref is what the item is about within its kind: the diagnostic kind,
or the completion window (ten_day, heating).

statement_document_id.description: StatementDocumentID is the statement's PDF, attached to every line.

amount_cents.description:
AmountCents is the whole charge; RecoverableCents the part recoverable
from the tenant (décret 87-713), 0 to the amount.

exercise_year.description: ExerciseYear defaults to the year of charged_on.

status.description:
Status is draft or confirmed (default); only confirmed charges are
reconciled.

decimal_point.description: DecimalPoint reads amounts as 1234.56; by default they read 1 234,56.

delimiter.description: Delimiter is one character; ";" when empty (the usual French export).

recoverable.description:
Recoverable is the syndic's recoverable amount of the line (décret
87-713); a line with an empty cell is recoverable for nothing.

cancellations.description:
Cancellations are the numbers of the documents that cancelled the
statements.

reason.description: Reason is stated on the cancelling documents.

amount_cents.description:
AmountCents is the whole charge; RecoverableCents the part recoverable
from the tenant (décret 87-713), 0 to the amount.

exercise_year.description: ExerciseYear defaults to the year of charged_on.

status.description:
Status is draft or confirmed (default); only confirmed charges are
reconciled.

syndic_recoverable_cents.description:
SyndicRecoverableCents is the syndic's own split of an imported line,
kept beside an owner's override.

days.description:
Days are the days of the year the asset was held, up to the as-of
day; VacantDays those it was let to no one.

gross_yield_bp.description:
GrossYieldBP is the rent over the acquisition price, and NetYieldBP
the net, in basis points a year (annualised over the days elapsed in
the current year); nil without an acquisition price.

interest_cents.description: InterestCents is the part of the expenses that is loan interest.

net_cents.description: NetCents is rent + other income − expenses.

provisions_received_cents.description:
ProvisionsReceivedCents is what the tenants paid towards the
recoverable charges; RecoverablePaidCents what the owner paid of
them. The difference is the regularisation to come.

interest_cents.description: InterestCents is the part of the expenses that is loan interest.

net_cents.description: NetCents is rent + other income − expenses.

provisions_received_cents.description:
ProvisionsReceivedCents is what the tenants paid towards the
recoverable charges; RecoverablePaidCents what the owner paid of
them. The difference is the regularisation to come.

partial.description: Partial says the year is not over: its figures run to AsOf.

portfolio.description:
Portfolio is the sum of every movement, those tied to no asset
included.

year_to_date.description: YearToDate and PreviousYear compare the same span of days.

kind.description:
Kind is the fee line kind (rent, provision, regularisation) when the
line comes from a fee.

current.description:
Current is the version new documents are rendered with: the latest,
since a template change only ever adds a version.

number.description:
Number is a generated document's number (AL-…, EE-…, RD-…), read from
its archive key; empty for an upload.

retain_until.description:
RetainUntil is unset while the retention clock has not started (a
lease document before the lease ends, Q-68): never eligible for deletion.

entry_inventory_id.description: An exit's entry, the return of the keys and the tenant's new address.

flagged.description:
Flagged counts the worse and missing results: what the owner must
qualify before the settlement.

accepted.description: Accepted is set once the request is decided.

entry.description:
Entry is the item's state at entry, corrected by the accepted
completion lines, for an exit item linked to its entry item.

dry_run.description: DryRun computes the statement without issuing it.

total_cents.description:
TotalCents is the balance plus the late penalty: what is paid back to
the tenant (negative: what the tenant still owes).

rent_cents.description: RentCents is the new rent: required for rent, optional for asset_add.

asset_id.description: AssetID is the asset the blocker is about, when it is about one (Q-105).

diagnostic.description:
Diagnostic is the diagnostic kind a missing or expired diagnostic, or the
DPE class, is about.

valid_until.description: ValidUntil is the last day an expired diagnostic was valid.

clauses.description:
Clauses are special clauses picked by code from the vetted list:
[{"code": "boiler_servicing"}] (RENT-SPEC-008).

inventory/items-field-retired; the structured items come with the
inventory capture.

months.description: Months is the notice period applied.

reduced.description: Reduced says a tenant's notice is the reduced one.

warnings.description:
Warnings are what the owner should check (a zone tendue ground on an
asset not flagged so).

LargeAgglomeration says the home is in an agglomeration of more than a
million inhabitants, which needs more references.

cap_cents.description: CapCents is the highest rent a zone tendue allows, when it applies.

increase_bp.description:
IncreaseBP is the increase over the current rent, in basis points,
rounded down.

references_mean_cents.description: ReferencesMeanCents is the mean of the references, rounded down.

renewal_on.description: RenewalOn is the first day of the renewed term.

steps.description: Steps is the yearly schedule of the increase, from the renewal.

steps_due.description:
StepsDue is how many steps of an accepted proposal are due and not yet
applied to the rent, on the day read.

solidary.description: Solidary defaults to true (clause de solidarité).

beyond_term.description:
BeyondTerm says a lease that does not renew runs past its term with
no end set: the owner should record how it goes on.

next_renewal_on.description:
NextRenewalOn is the first day of the next tacit renewal, when the
lease renews and no end is set.

closed.description:
Closed says the year's tax summary is issued: its figures no longer
change (Q-127).

annual_rate_ppm.description:
AnnualRatePPM is the nominal annual rate in parts per million (3.45 %
is 34500); required for a computed table.

document_id.description:
DocumentID is the bank's offer or table, uploaded through POST
/documents.

remaining_cents.description: RemainingCents is the principal still owed at the year's end.

iban_last4.description:
IBANLast4 is the last four characters of the IBAN, to tell accounts
apart; the full IBAN is never stored.

date_format.description: DateFormat is a Go layout; 02/01/2006 when empty.

decimal_point.description: DecimalPoint reads amounts as 1234.56; by default they read 1 234,56.

delimiter.description: Delimiter is one character; ";" when empty (the usual French export).

auto_match.description:
AutoMatch applies the payment to the lease's oldest unpaid rent calls
(POST only; default false).

collective_building.description:
CollectiveBuilding is an asset in a building under a syndic: its
annual accounts gate the deposit holdback (RENT-INV-001 §6).

shares.description: Shares defaults to 100 % for the owner of the scope.

commit.description:
Commit and BuildTime come from the stamp, or from Go's VCS stamp of an
unstamped build; empty when neither is known (go run).

modified.description:
Modified says an unstamped build was made from a tree with local
changes.

schema.description:
Schema is the last migration embedded in the binary (applied by
tenure migrate up).

stamped.description: Stamped says the binary was built by scripts/build.sh (a release).

version.description: Version is the release tag stamped by scripts/build.sh, or "dev".

release.description: Release is the tag pinned in web/VERSION, empty when none is.
